intro: The steppe offers room for manoeuvre—and punishes every commander who hesitates. The First Cavalry Army is turning mobility into strategic shock. We have overthrown the Tsar but that has not stopped the capitalists, monarchists and other enemies of the people to unite, raise forces and march on our people's republic! Petrograd lies under attack and Siberia is under enemy control. The wider stakes are clear: The smell of capitalists fleeing from the people's army is in the air. A strong result opens the road to ROSTOV (6 January 1920). Your horses cannot replace armour in a frontal attack, but they can turn a retreat into annihilation.

intro: The steppe offers room for manoeuvre—and punishes every commander who hesitates. The First Cavalry Army is turning mobility into strategic shock. Your army has not been defeated and is close to dealing another crucial blow to the capitalist's cause in southern Russia! The capitalist armies are ever retreating further south. The wider stakes are clear: AFTERMATH: By the end of 1919 the White armies in Siberia, western Russia and the Ukraine had been contained and defeated by the victorious Red Army. A strong result opens the road to BATTLE OF VOLODARKA (29 May 1920). Ride around resistance, strike artillery and supply columns, and close the trap before the enemy understands the danger.

briliant.text:
Yes, comrade. This is an impressive piece of mobile warfare! You were even faster in Rostov than some of the capitalist's troops! Roam the countryside and liberate the towns and villages of the provinces from the capitalists and monarchists. They deserve to be free! Hunt down every last traitor of the people!

AFTERMATH:
By the end of 1919 the White armies in Siberia, western Russia and the Ukraine had been contained and defeated by the victorious Red Army. Although isolated troops and bands continued to roam around, the only organized resistance was put up by General Wrangel on the Crimea. However, with peace so close by for the Bolshevik government, the tide seemed to turn again and not for the better...

intro: A cavalry force wins not by battering the strongest point, but by appearing where the enemy thought no army could be. The First Cavalry Army is turning mobility into strategic shock. Finally all of your command has arrived at the new front in the west. The newly emerged Polish state has invaded our sacred territory both in the Belarus as here in the Ukraine. The wider stakes are clear: However the fighting with the Polish cavalry showed that the people's Cavalry Army is a superior army! A strong result opens the road to KIEV COUNTEROFFENSIVE (9 June 1920). Scout first, avoid prepared strongpoints, and use speed to seize crossings, junctions, and retreat routes.

A major offensive by our armies north and south of Kiev has pushed back the Polish bandits. Even blind people can see that Kiev is about to fall. The wider stakes are clear: The Ukrainian capital has been liberated! The people of the Ukraine are now free from the capitalists who have ruled them for the past few weeks. A strong result opens the road to DELAY AT ROVNO (1 July 1920). Ride around resistance, strike artillery and supply columns, and close the trap before the enemy understands the danger.

briliant.text:
Comrade! Kiev is liberated! Imagine the headline of tomorrow's newspaper! "The Ukrainian capital has been liberated!" The people of the Ukraine are now free from the capitalists who have ruled them for the past few weeks.

Also, I assume you know what to do with the Ukrainian prisoners of war? They are traitors of their own people. They allied themselves with the very power that invaded their country and they deserve nothing but the final penalty.

intro: The steppe offers room for manoeuvre—and punishes every commander who hesitates. The First Cavalry Army is turning mobility into strategic shock. A few days ago while you were busy trying to capture Lwow; the Polish imperialists started a counteroffensive pushing through the center of the line between Lwow and Warsaw. After their breakthrough they turned north and now the entire northern command is retreating in order not to be encircled! The wider stakes are clear: NOTEWORTHY: Because of the numbers of forces involved, the Battle of Komarow is considered the greatest cavalry battle of the 20th century. Your horses cannot replace armour in a frontal attack, but they can turn a retreat into annihilation.

briliant.text:
Here, quickly, comrade! A squadron of our loyal Cossacks have made a corridor through which we can escape! Though not mauled, we have suffered a moral defeat from the Polish cavalry. Worst of all, we have been denied access to the north and our entire front in Poland is rapidly collapsing...

NOTEWORTHY: Because of the numbers of forces involved, the Battle of Komarow is considered the greatest cavalry battle of the 20th century. Also it was the last battle fought mostly by cavalry units, in which traditional cavalry tactics were used and sabers and lances played a vital role.

intro: Preserve the army today so that it can fight—and win—tomorrow. The First Cavalry Army is turning mobility into strategic shock. Comrade have I ever told you why I joined the Bolshevik party? The Northern armies will have to retreat on their own to defensive positions while we prepare to strike again and then finally make the wishes of millions of proletarians come true! The wider stakes are clear: The capitalists in Warsaw realize that further struggles with the People's Republic will inevitably will lead their defeat! A strong result opens the road to KAKHOVKA (20 October 1920). Rear guards must buy time while the main body escapes; abandon cohesion and the campaign may end here.

briliant.text:
Our armies are safe, comrade. Thanks to your excellent rearguard duty slowing down the Polish army in the south long enough for us to retreat to better positions. The front is stabilizing again locally. Plus I have orders for our command to be pulled out of the frontline. That means rest and refitting for the first time in months!

---Some weeks later at the local HQ---

Good news, comrade! The capitalists in Warsaw realize that further struggles with the People's Republic will inevitably will lead their defeat! Though not all of our claims have been recognized in the cease fire, we now have peace at our western borders! That means we finally have a border instead of a front!

Sadly that is not true for the southern border...
